title: Smart data models - Platform schema
description: A Platform is an entity that hosts other entities, particularly Sensors, Actuators, Samplers, and other Platforms.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be equal to `Platform`

hosts.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Platform and a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, hosted or mounted on it.

isHostedBy.description: Property. Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by.
